excerpt: An American music student researching a late composer falls for his son at the family’s French estate, learns she is the image of the girl he lost, and begins to suspect she was invited for sinister reasons.
title: Crescendo

excerpt: On a South Pacific island, Martin and Lewis knockoffs Duke Mitchell and Sammy Petrillo run afoul of mad scientist Bela Lugosi and his devolution serum.
title: Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla

excerpt: A teen travels into an absurdist hell to rescue his fiancée after she’s abducted by a demonic cop with scripture verses carved into his face.
title: Highway to Hell

excerpt: A woman kills to feed her lover, her husband’s half-resurrected brother, while the creatures he escaped from close in.
title: Hellraiser

excerpt: A black-gloved killer thins the ranks of a New York dance troupe competing for three spots in a new show, dispatching the best first.
title: Murder-Rock: Dancing Death
